# Acid1 fixture attribution

`acid1-reference.png` is the accompanying WPT reference image from
`css/CSS2/css1/support/css1test5526c.png`.

`acid1.html` is adapted from the Web Platform Tests CSS1 fixture:
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/css/CSS2/css1/c5526c-display-000.xht

Original test: CSS1 Test Suite Contributors and Ian Hickson.
The local HTML adaptation removes CSS CDATA delimiters. Test styles and layout markup are unchanged.
